svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: OAuth sign-in with S256 PKCE and signed one-use state
svg.desc: Sequence of the numbered steps: 1. SPA auth service to OAuth router (POST authorize + challenge); 2. OAuth router to audit_logs (record pending attempt); 3. OAuth router to SPA auth service (signed state, 10 min); 4. SPA auth service to sessionStorage attempt (keep verifier); 5. SPA auth service to Google or GitHub (redirect with challenge); 6. Google or GitHub to SPA auth service (callback with code, state); 7. SPA auth service to sessionStorage attempt (consume attempt); 8. SPA auth service to OAuth router (POST callback + verifier); 9. OAuth router to audit_logs (check signature + S256 verifier, consume once); 10. OAuth router to Google or GitHub (exchange code + verifier); 11. OAuth router to Google or GitHub (fetch profile (subject) and verified email); 12. OAuth router to users (match or create user by subject); 13. OAuth router to audit_logs (record refresh JTI, sign JWTs); 14. OAuth router to SPA auth service (access + refresh tokens); 15. SPA auth service to OAuth router (GET /api/auth/me); 16. SPA auth service to Auth store (install user + tokens)

text.tspan: OAUTH SIGN-IN WITH S256 PKCE AND SIGNED ONE-USE STATE
Happy path in 16 steps: the signed 10-minute state is recorded in audit_logs and consumed once before the provider exchange
MATCH OR CREATE USER BY SUBJECT
